🍂MY SEPTEMBER TO-DO LIST🍂 1. Pick a new fave: My local go-to cafés are changing out their menus for the season. It's time to sample the new drink offerings. A current fave? The Poison Apple energy drink from the local Chaos & Caffeine truck! 2. Pick up some seasonal reads: I'm personally on the hunt for some fresh folk horror in the vein of STARVE ACRE! 3. Marathon a mystery series: For me, it's @onlymurdersonhulu in anticipation of the new season this December! What will you be doing this fall?

🍂WHAT'S NEW THIS AUTUMN?🍂 📙Mystery novels - It's the perfect time for a cozy crime! Check out @aukstudiosofficial 's SIR SHERLOCK series, featuring Tom Baker as Sherlock Holmes and John Leeson as Dr. Watson! 🫖 Autumn teas - @drinkchapters is rolling out new and classic fall flavors, including the return of Headless Horseman (a personal fave!) 🕯️Autumn candles - @frostbeardstudio has brought back their autumn seasonal collection of bookish soy wax candles! #falltok🍁 #booktok
I’m why Faction Paradox has a wrestling branch. #authortok

🍂3 THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW THIS AUTUMN🍂 1. Fall flavors at chain stores are great, but some of the best are at local spots! Check nearby independently-owned cafés and bakeries for the truly unique autumn treats. 2. You don't have to wait for the temperature to go down to start living your best fall life! (And if you live in a region like I do, it may take a while anyway.) Do what feels cozy, and take advantage of rainy days for maximum fall vibes. 3. Pumpkin spice isn't the only fall flavor! Try

Robin, Espresso, and Percy. You’ll probably be seeing a lot more of them on here. They love the attention. (Also Espresso turns seven next month!)  #guineapig #guineapigsoftiktok #wfh #petsoftiktok #pets
